      • addEventHandlers

        public MulticastParameters.Builder addEventHandlers​(List<MulticastClientEventHandler> handlers)
        Adds the specified event handlers to the multicast client event handlers.

        Previously configured event handlers are retained.

        Parameters:
        handlers - the multicast client event handlers to add
        Returns:
        this builder
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if handlers is null or contains a null handler

      • withEventHandlers

        public MulticastParameters.Builder withEventHandlers​(List<MulticastClientEventHandler> handlers)
        Replaces the multicast client event handlers with the specified handlers.

        Any previously configured event handlers are removed.

        Parameters:
        handlers - the multicast client event handlers to use
        Returns:
        this builder
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if handlers is null or contains a null handler
